title: Industrial land priced at $450,000 per acre
subtitle: Holding zone removal in Elora, Union Street pumping station study, a tax write-off and financial reports
overview: Council set the 2023 price for municipally owned industrial land at $450,000 per acre. The price applies to the Centre Wellington Business Park and other Township-owned industrial sites. Staff answered questions on protecting environmentally sensitive lands in the park, zoning measures to streamline planning, the target audience for sales, and road construction to connect Dickson Drive to First Line.

Council also removed a holding zone from part of 94 Wellington Road 7 in Elora and passed the matching zoning by-law, which allows that phase to move ahead. It received a report on the start of a Class Environmental Assessment for expanding the Union Street sewage pumping station. The study will identify a preferred way to increase capacity. Council approved a tax write-off under section 354 of the Municipal Act.

Council received operating results and a capital projects status report, both to June 30, 2023, for information. The Mayor said County Council does not meet in August and had nothing to report. Council approved the Committee of the Whole report of August 14, 2023 {{vote:m1}}.

decisions.detail: Council approved a price of $450,000 per acre for municipally owned industrial land in the Business Park and other Township industrial sites {{vote:m2}}.
Council approved removing the holding zone symbol from a portion of the Elora property and gave three readings to the by-law {{vote:m3}}.
Council passed By-law 2023-68, amending Zoning By-law 2009-045 to remove the holding zone symbol from certain land {{vote:m6}}.
Council received for information the notice that a Class Environmental Assessment has begun on expanding the Union Street sewage pumping station {{vote:m4}}.
Council approved the tax write-off in report COR2023-85 under section 354 of the Municipal Act {{vote:m5}}.
